jobs.title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build advanced models to understand and solve complex data problems through advanced modelling. Work with Data Engineers and Data Analysts to determine relevant internal and external data sources for developing predictive and descriptive models. Drive AI/ML innovation within ANZ's enterprise data function.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Join the Rail Network Renewals Engineering Team. Develop and maintain data pipelines supporting AI and advanced analytics solutions designed to help teams operate safely and efficiently. Occasional FIFO to Dampier site. Work alongside Senior Data Scientists and Technical Leads on production analytics infrastructure.

jobs.title: Graduate Program – Technology & Data Science 2027
jobs.snippet: BHP's Graduate Program accepts candidates with backgrounds in Data Science, Computer Science, Cloud Computing, Analytics, Applied Statistics, Information Technology, and Mathematics. Opportunities at mine and rail network sites across Western Australia, Queensland Bowen Basin, South Australia, and offices in Perth, Brisbane and Adelaide.

jobs.title: Staff / Lead Platform Engineer (ML & AI)
jobs.snippet: Build and productionise ML models, pipelines and AI systems at scale. Collaborate with data scientists, product teams and infrastructure engineers to translate ML research into production systems. CommBank is on a mission to lead in Generative AI and Agentic AI with teams tackling complex, high-impact data challenges.

jobs.title: AI Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Help design, develop and improve AI solutions that turn data into safe, reliable decisions, enhancing customer experiences, lifting productivity and reducing risk. Build production-grade LLM solutions using AWS and Anthropic within CommBank's AI Centre of Excellence. Work on Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build high-quality data assets and modern data platforms at SEEK, Australia's largest employment marketplace. Drive data engineering innovation across the enterprise environment. Own the full data lifecycle from ingestion to serving, supporting SEEK's AI-driven matching and recommendation systems.

jobs.title: Mid-Level ML Engineer
jobs.snippet: Hands-on AI/ML role across defence, space and civilian sectors. Build and deploy machine learning models for complex real-world applications. Full-time hybrid position based in Brisbane. Requires 2–4 years of ML engineering experience with Python and ML frameworks.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Program – Technology
jobs.snippet: EY's Technology degree pathway unlocks careers in Digital Engineering and AI. Tackle real business challenges, collaborate with high-performing teams, and make a meaningful impact from day one. 12-month graduate development program with coaching, mentoring and structured development. Must be an Australian/NZ Citizen or Australian Permanent Resident.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Program – Data Analytics
jobs.snippet: In EY's AI and Data team, use the latest thinking and innovation to solve complex business challenges and transform clients into intelligent information organisations. Specialisations in data analytics, AI/ML modelling and data strategy. Eligibility: final year or within 24 months of graduation; must be AU/NZ citizen or AU PR.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Shape the future of Data and AI governance within AGL's Energy Assets group. Analyze asset data and build models and dashboards to optimise performance of renewable energy assets. Design and deliver data accuracy frameworks. Work on ML models for energy grid forecasting and demand prediction.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Technology Program
jobs.snippet: Telstra's Graduate Program with AI and machine learning at the top of their priority list. Work with Data Scientists on exciting AI/ML projects shaping the future of telecommunications. Commencing February 2027. Eligible: graduates from 2024, 2025 and 2026. Australian citizenship or permanent residency required.

jobs.title: Data Engineer – AI & Analytics
jobs.snippet: Build and maintain data pipelines powering AI-driven network analytics at nbn Australia. Develop scalable data infrastructure supporting AI leadership initiatives across the enterprise. Collaborate with data science and engineering teams on modern cloud-based data platform projects.

jobs.title: Graduate Data & Analytics Program
jobs.snippet: Join Mondelēz International's Data & Analytics graduate program to drive insight and impact across one of the world's leading snacking companies. Work on consumer analytics, supply chain data science and AI-driven decision support. 18-month rotational program across different business functions.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: Highly motivated AI Engineer to join Simplyai's growing Data & AI practice. Build and deploy AI solutions across client engagements. Requires 2–4 years experience with Python, ML frameworks and cloud AI platforms. Work on GenAI and LLM solutions for enterprise clients across Australia.

jobs.title: AI Associate Program
jobs.snippet: The Consortio AI Associate Program is designed to help junior and graduate technology professionals build real careers in AI. Hands-on program covering LLM engineering, RAG systems, agentic AI and production deployment. Ideal for graduates in CS, engineering or related disciplines looking to specialise in AI.

jobs.title: 推荐算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 网易2026届暑期实习招聘，推荐算法方向。参与用户推荐系统的模型研发，探索深度学习、强化学习等前沿技术在推荐场景中的应用。要求计算机、数学等相关专业在读研究生，熟悉主流ML框架，有推荐系统或搜索广告相关项目经验优先。

jobs.title: 推荐算法工程师（B-UP计划）
jobs.snippet: 哔哩哔哩B-UP顶尖技术人才项目，面向2027届毕业生。深度参与B站推荐算法系统研发，提升用户个性化体验。要求在顶会（CVPR/ACL/NeurIPS/ICML等）发表论文，或在Kaggle/ACM-ICPC等赛事中取得成绩。工作地点：上海/北京。

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: OPPO 2026届寻梦实习计划，AI算法类岗位。参与大模型及轻量化算法研究与工程落地，聚焦端云协同、推理框架优化、Agent方向。实习满2个月可参与转录用答辩，通过后毕业即入职。招聘城市：深圳/东莞。

jobs.title: 风控ML算法工程师
jobs.snippet: 负责滴滴出行平台智能风控算法的研发与迭代，利用机器学习、深度学习技术构建风控模型，提升平台安全性。要求3年以上ML工程经验，熟悉XGBoost、LightGBM及深度学习框架，有互联网风控或金融风控项目背景优先。

jobs.title: 端侧大模型算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: vivo 2026届暑期实习，AI算法类岗位。研究大模型在移动端的高效部署与推理优化，探索模型量化、蒸馏、剪枝等轻量化技术。要求计算机、人工智能相关专业在读本硕博，熟悉PyTorch/TensorFlow，有端侧AI项目经验优先。

jobs.title: 自然语言处理算法实习生
jobs.snippet: 蚂蚁集团2026年暑期实习NLP算法方向。参与大模型后训练（SFT/RLHF）、金融领域垂直大模型研发及智能体优化。要求计算机、AI相关专业在读研究生，熟悉Transformer架构及主流NLP框架，有大模型相关项目经验优先。

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师（2027届）
jobs.snippet: 美团2027届校园招聘，大模型算法工程师岗位。参与美团智能化平台大模型研发，聚焦本地生活场景的AI应用，涵盖搜索推荐、多模态内容理解、AI Agent等方向。要求计算机、AI相关专业硕博应届生，有大模型工程经验优先。

jobs.title: 广告算法工程师（2027届）
jobs.snippet: 腾讯2027届校招，广告算法方向。负责腾讯广告系统的算法研发，包括CTR/CVR预估、用户意图理解、多目标排序等。参与混元大模型在广告业务场景的应用探索。要求计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业硕博应届生。

jobs.title: 用户理解算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 小红书2026暑期实习，用户理解算法方向。研究用户行为建模、兴趣图谱、个性化推荐等算法，提升小红书内容发现效率。要求计算机或数学相关专业在读研究生，熟悉推荐系统及图神经网络，有用户行为分析项目经验优先。

jobs.title: AI算法工程师（2027届）
jobs.snippet: 联想2027届校园招聘，AI算法工程师方向。参与智能终端AI能力研发，涵盖大模型端侧部署、计算机视觉、自然语言处理等方向。助力联想AI PC及智能设备创新。要求计算机、人工智能相关专业本硕应届生，熟悉深度学习框架。

jobs.title: 大模型推理优化算法工程师
jobs.snippet: 荣耀大模型团队，负责端侧大模型推理优化，研究量化、蒸馏、稀疏化等压缩技术，提升大模型在荣耀设备上的推理速度与效率。要求深度学习及模型部署经验，熟悉TensorRT/ONNX/TFLite等推理框架，3年以上相关工作经验。

jobs.title: AI推荐算法工程师（实习）
jobs.snippet: 小米2026暑期实习，AI推荐算法方向。参与小米商城、应用商店、内容平台的推荐算法研发，探索大模型在推荐场景中的应用。要求计算机、数学相关专业在读研究生，熟悉推荐系统及深度学习，有实习或竞赛经验优先。
